Authored fixtures for the Legal federal-statutes feature (#2105). Every statute, act, decision,
dossier and EU act here is fictional ("Musterpapierhandelsgesetz - MPHG", BGBl. 2030 I Nr. 45,
Directive (EU) 2030/77, ...). The files follow the documented shapes of gesetze-im-internet.de
(gii-toc.xml, gii-norm XML), rechtsinformationen.bund.de (JSON-LD search, LegalDocML.de) and
recht.bund.de (RSS listing, LegalDocML.de promulgation) as recorded, unverified-live, in
docs/development/federal-statutes-evidence/source-audit.md. None of it is live coverage.
